subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should interrupted subagent completion announce delivery turns be persisted as announce-only lifecycle state, reconciled to `killed`, and forced tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The code appears correct for the incident, but the PR defines durable session-state and security-boundary semantics that automated review cannot safely make permanent without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept announce-only recovery contract
options.body: Merge with `announceLastRun`, `killed` reconciliation, and cross-runtime tool isolation as the intended behavior for announce delivery turns.

options.title: Adjust the lifecycle state before merge
options.body: Keep the tool-free invariant but change the reconciled status or marker shape if `killed` is not the right support/debug contract.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery model
options.body: Hold the PR if announce delivery should be redesigned as a separate non-session delivery lane instead of patching parent-topic recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept announce-only recovery contract
recommendation.body: Merge with `announceLastRun`, `killed` reconciliation, and cross-runtime tool isolation as the intended behavior for announce delivery turns.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh has the clearest recent overlap with restart lifecycle seams and Codex internal-turn/tool-boundary behavior touched by this PR.
